canvas-white.$description: Canvas White — Page background, card surface, image plate — the entire site sits on pure white

ink-black.$description: Ink Black — All text, hairline borders, navigation, link underlines, image frames — the sole structural color

terminal-lime.$description: Terminal Lime — Footer band, surface highlight wash, terminal accent — high-chroma green that signals a page boundary the way a colored edge stops a gallery wall

signal-red.$description: Signal Red — Decorative border strokes, icon outlines, hairline rules in editorial layouts — used at sub-readable contrast as graphic punctuation, never as body text

helveticaneuepro.$description: Universal type family for navigation, body, headings, inputs, and footer — the only weight on the site (400), set in all-caps across the nav and footer, with positive tracking 0.0140em–0.0240em that gives the single weight a mechanical, catalog-like cadence
